question: Change the Data field on corev1.Secret (k8s.io/api/core/v1) from map[string][]byte to a new named type SecretData with encryption-at-rest semantics and different accessor methods. Secret.Data is directly accessed by any controller or tool that reads/writes credentials, TLS certificates, tokens, or configuration stored in Kubernetes Secrets. Any code using secret.Data[key] map access syntax or assigning map[string][]byte literals will break.
